title: David Montgomery’s record-tying debut headlines Week 1’s AFC Secret Superstars

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: David Montgomery’s record-tying debut headlines Week 1’s AFC Secret Superstars
sources.description: The Texans' new back tied an NFL record with three touchdowns in his team debut — and he's not the only afterthought making noise, as Jacksonville's Parker Washington and Las Vegas' Kwity Paye prove Week 1 breakouts weren't a fluke.
